Topic: Software Engineering and
Information System Design:

Analysis of System Maintenance and upgrading.

Mathematical reasoning, Algebraic structures, Graphs.

Topic: 1. Computer Architecture: 
Instructions and data access methods, Processor design, Memory

2. Communication Theory: 
Spectral analysis, Information theory, Analog communication

Multiplexing.

Topic: Microprocessor and Interfacing: 
Introduction to microprocessor, difference between
microprocessor and microcontroller, Introduction to 8086/8088,
Microprocessor programming, Tools, Clock and bus controller

interfacing, Serial I/O interface, Interrupts, DMA.

Topic: 1. Electrical Circuits:
Circuit variables and elements, Basic laws of electrical circuits,
Simple resistive circuits, Methods of analysis, Circuit theorems,
Capacitors and inductors, Series and parallel AC circuits.

2. Basic Electronics: 
Diode circuit, Bipolar junction transistors, Single stage
amplifier: Field effect transistor (FET).

Electromagnetic waves, Photoelectric effect, Quantum theory of
light, X-ray and X-ray diffraction.
